crossRefs.note: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
“Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his…
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out…
Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is…
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and…
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
“With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
“Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it…
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the…
For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…

translations.web: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
translations.bsb: The Almighty is beyond our reach; He is exalted in power! In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress.
translations.kjv: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
translations.asv: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out He is excellent in power; And in justice and plenteous righteousness he will not afflict.
